job.title: Director of Nursing
job.description:
Overview

We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing to lead and inspire our nursing team while ensuring the provision of the highest quality healthcare services. This role will play a pivotal part in providing strategic and operational leadership across all aspects of nursing care, clinical governance, and nursing management. The ideal candidate will combine a passion for patient care, exceptional leadership abilities, and a commitment to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work culture.

Responsibilities

  • Provide effective leadership to the nursing team, fostering an environment of growth, collaboration, and professional excellence.
  • Develop and implement strategies to achieve outstanding patient outcomes while maintaining compliance with clinical regulations and governance standards.
  • Oversee the planning, organization, and management of all nursing operations, ensuring consistency in delivering safe, patient-centered care.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to promote interdepartmental communication and achieve organizational goals.
  • Maintain accountability for the performance, development, and evaluation of nursing staff, ensuring opportunities for training and continuous professional growth.
  • Lead initiatives aimed at improving equity, cultural competence, and understanding within the team to serve diverse patient populations effectively.
  • Conduct regular audits and evaluations to monitor service quality and implement improvements based on findings.
  • Rigorously monitor budgets, resources, and staffing levels to ensure efficient delivery of services.
  • Establish and uphold policies and procedures that reflect best practices in nursing and clinical governance.

Qualifications

  • Current and valid professional nursing license.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Nursing (BSN) is required; a Master’s degree in Nursing, Healthcare Administration, or a related field is strongly preferred.
  • Minimum of 8 years of nursing experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership or nursing management role.
  • Demonstrated experience in clinical governance and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare regulations, compliance standards, and best practices in patient care.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Outstanding interpersonal and communication abilities, with a proven track record of fostering team cohesion and engagement.
  • A commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in both leadership ethos and patient care delivery.

Day-to-Day

  • Lead, mentor, and support a multidisciplinary team of nursing professionals.
  • Conduct regular assessments of nursing practices, ensuring adherence to accreditation and regulatory requirements.
  • Serve as a point of contact between senior leadership, nursing staff, and other departments.
  • Facilitate ongoing training programs to enhance the professional competencies of nursing staff.
  • Monitor patient care outcomes and address any discrepancies proactively.
  • Respond to critical incidents effectively and guide the team through problem resolution.
  • Engage with patients, their families, and stakeholders to promote satisfaction and trust in care services.
  • Review and approve work schedules for nursing personnel, ensuring adequate staffing levels.

Elevate patient care and make a lasting impact on our organization as our next Director of Nursing. Join us to lead with compassion, innovation, and excellence while fostering a culture of respect, equity, and inclusion.

job.title: Consultant (Plastic Surgeon)
job.description:
Job Title: Consultant (Plastic Surgeon)

Location: Singapore

About Our Client

Our client is a well-established and leading public healthcare institution in Singapore, renowned for its excellence in medical care, education, and research. As one of the country’s major tertiary hospitals, it provides comprehensive and specialized medical services, including advanced reconstructive and plastic surgery. With a strong commitment to innovation, patient care, and multidisciplinary collaboration, the institution offers a dynamic and fulfilling environment for medical professionals looking to advance their careers in reconstructive and aesthetic surgery.

Responsibilities

The selected candidate will be responsible for providing expert surgical care in plastic, reconstructive, and aesthetic procedures. Key responsibilities include:

  • Performing craniomaxillofacial reconstruction for congenital anomalies, trauma, and post-tumor excision.
  • Managing facial paralysis treatment.
  • Conducting scar management using advanced reconstructive and aesthetic techniques.
  • Performing benign skin lesion removal and skin cancer surgeries.
  • Executing trauma and post-oncologic reconstruction.
  • Managing lymphoedema treatment and surgery.
  • Performing rib fracture fixation and reconstruction for trauma patients.
  • Overseeing chronic wound care.
  • Collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to ensure holistic and patient-centered care.

Requirements

  • Recognized medical degree from an accredited institution.
  • Specialist accreditation in Plastic Surgery from a recognized board or institution.
  • Eligible for medical registration with the Singapore Medical Council (SMC) and specialist accreditation with the Specialist Accreditation Board (SAB), Ministry of Health, Singapore.
  • Extensive experience in plastic, reconstructive, and aesthetic surgery, particularly in trauma and oncologic reconstruction.
  • Fellowship training in craniomaxillofacial or reconstructive microsurgery.
  • Proficiency in microvascular and free flap techniques is advantageous.
  • Strong clinical expertise, excellent patient communication skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary environment.

Ideal Candidate

  • Skilled and experienced in plastic and reconstructive surgery.
  • Detail-oriented and committed to excellence in patient care, surgical precision, and multidisciplinary collaboration.
  • Strong communicator and team player, working seamlessly with specialists across various disciplines.
  • Dedicated to medical education and mentorship, fostering the next generation of plastic surgeons.
  • Actively engaged in clinical research and innovation, driving improvements in reconstructive surgical outcomes.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a dynamic and collaborative team, making a meaningful contribution to the medical field while advancing your career in a leading healthcare institution. If you meet the requirements and are interested in this exciting role, we encourage you to apply.

Informal enquiries may be directed to Liza@people360.com.sg. Interested individuals are invited to submit a letter of interest and a full academic curriculum vitae to the same email.

  • Perform complex oncological surgeries, including minimally invasive and radical procedures.
  • Develop and oversee individualized treatment plans involving surgery, chemotherapy, and radiotherapy.
  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, including medical and radiation oncologists, pathologists, and palliative care specialists.
  • Provide counseling and support for patients regarding treatment options, prognosis, and fertility preservation.
  • Supervise and mentor junior doctors, residents, and medical students in gynecologic oncology.

  2. Relevant post-graduate qualifications recognized by the Singapore Medical Council, either 1 of the 4.
    • Certification by one of the Royal Colleges in Australia or New Zealand.
    • Certification by one of the medical specialty boards of the American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS).
    • Specialist Certification by the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada.
    • Fellowship with the Hong Kong Academy or College
  3. Certificate of Completion of Training (CCT or CCST) awarded by a competent authority of the UK or Ireland (Please note CESR is not recognized in Singapore) OR AHPRA Specialist Registration
